decisions.choice: An independent fail-closed IMAGE_FALLBACK_ENABLED controls universal policy; IMAGE_INPUT_ENABLED continues to control staging. Capture universal once per accepted request and recheck input after slot acquisition.

consequences: No fleet mutation or fake proofs.

Input disable propagates on next post-slot check subject to its existing <=1s cache; accepted running CLI is not retroactively cancelled.
